name: Staged data center closings in Genesee County and Graham
method: Each event is a statement supported by the cited agreement, issuer report, or agency filing. Requested load, substation contract scope, closing consideration and customer service are separate observations. An omitted value means the cited documents do not establish it.

locations.project: New York Gateway, Western New York Science & Technology Advanced Manufacturing Park (STAMP)
locations.jurisdiction: Town of Alabama, Genesee County, New York

events.observation: The seller's substation package described 265 MW of associated contracted energy and power. The transaction contemplated conveying the substation package to the GCEDC.
The amendment authorized escrow release and a separate interim land closing and set out a conditional seller repurchase right. The two amounts would be credited if the overall transaction closed.
The project docket links the updated plan submission. This records a planning step.

August amendment and separate equipment sale
events.observation: The parties reported a separate closing for high-voltage equipment. The amended terms put the land and the remaining interconnection assets on a separate closing path.
